description: This file defines the TaxService interface in the package com.salesmanager.core.business.tax.service, outlining methods for retrieving and saving tax configurations and calculating taxes on orders.

classes.name: TaxService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for managing tax configurations and calculating taxes for orders within a sales management system.

methods.name: getTaxConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves tax configurations (TaxConfiguration) for a given MerchantStore.

methods.name: calculateTax
methods.description: Calculates tax over an OrderSummary, considering customer, store, and language context.
